content: Muse Be7ana Yootore Yeeth
Midiyaame biitta qeese, Muse bollo Yootorey, Xoossay Musessinne iza asaa Isra7eele naytas ooththidayssa hessika GODAY istta Gibxe biittafe kessidayssa ubbaa siyides.

He wode Muse bollo Yootorey, Musey guye zaari moyzida Muse machcheyo Xipooronne izi nam7u nayta banara ekki yides. Museykka, «Tani asa biittan bete as gidadis» gishe bayra naaza Gershoome gi sunththides.
Qasseka, «Ta aawaa Xoossi tana maaddides; izi tana Gibxe kawo toorappe ashshides» gishe Nam7anththo naaza El7ezeere gi sunththides.
Muse bollo Yootorey Muse attuma naytaranne Muse machcheyra gididi bazzon Xoossa zuma achchan diza Musekko yides.
Izi, «Tani ne bollo Yootorey, ne machcheyranne izi nayta nam7atara neekko he boos» giidi kiita Musekko yeddides.
Hessa gishshas Musey ba bollozara gaagganaas kezidi hokkidi iza yeerides. Istti issoy issaa saroththidaappe guye Muse dunkaane giddo gelida.
GODAY Isra7eele asaa gishshas Gibxe kawo bollanne Gibxe asaa bolla ooththidayssa, oge bolla istta gakkida daaburanne GODAY istta ashshidayssa ubbaa Musey ba bollozas yootides.
Isra7eele asaa, Gibxe asaa kusheppe ashshanaas GODAY ooththida lo7o ooso ubbaa siyidi Yootorey ufayettides.
«Inttena Gibxe asaa kusheppenne kawo Paaroone kusheppe ashshida GODAY ba asaa Gibxe asaa kusheppe kessi ekkidayssi izi galatetto.
Izi Isra7eele asaa bolla otorettidaytas hayssa ooththida gishshas GODAY hara eeqa xoossata ubbaafe gooba gididayssa tani ha7i eradis» gides.
Hessafe guye Muse bollo Yootorey xuugettiza yarsho qasseka hara yarshota Xoossas shiishshides. Aarooneynne Isra7eele cimati wuri Xoossa sinththan Muse bollozara kath maanaas yida.
Deres Pirdiza Asati Doorettida
Wonteththa gallas Musey asaas pirdanaas uttiin asay iza sinththan yiidi yiidi eqqiza gishshas Musey maaladoppe omarsa wode gakkanaas uttides.

Muse bolloy Musey asaas ooththizayssa ubbaa be7idi, «Neni ha asaas ooththizayssi hayssi aazee? Hayssi asay wuri maaladoppe doommidi omarsa wode gakkanaas ne sinththan yiidi yiidi eqqishin, maadoy baynda asa mala neni nerkka ays pirdas uttadii?» gides.
Histtiin Musey ba bollozas, «Asay Xoossa shene oychchanaas taakko yiza gishshassa.
Istta giddon yo7oy diikko taakko yeettes; tanikka istta giddon diza yo7o pirdays; Xoossa maaraanne wogaa istta erisays» gides.
Yootoreykka, «Hayssi neni ooththizayssi lo7o deenna.
Neninne nenara diza asay daabura xalala daabureeta; hayssi oosozi nees daro deexo; neni hayssa nerkka ooththanaas dandayakka.
Ane ha7i ta nena zorays! Ta yootizayssa siya; Xoossi nenara gido. Neni ha asaa gishshas Xoossa sinththan eqqa; asaza yo7okka Xoossako shiishsha.
Xoossa maaraanne wogaa istta neni tamaarsa; istti waani daanaakko istti ooththana ooso istta bessa.
Qasse asa ubbaa giddofe era asata, Xoossas babbizayta, ammanettidaytanne matta7e ixxizayta doorada isttafe asaas shaalaqata, mato halaqata, hamsa halaqatanne asira halaqata histta sunththa.
Istti ubba wode asaas pirdetto; gido attiin deexo yo7o ubbaa neekko ehetto; waayisontta yo7o ubbaa istti heen wursetto. Istti nenara gishettiza gishshas toohoy nees kawuyana.
Neni hessaththo ooththiko hayssi Xoossa shene gidikko neni daro daaburakka. Qasse ha asay wurikka ba yo7oy polettiin ufayssan ba soo ba soo baana» gides.
Musey ba bolloza qaala siyides; izi gidayssa ubbaaka ooththides.
Musey Isra7eele ubbaa giddofe era asata dooridi asaa kaaleththiza shaalaqata, mato halaqata, hamsa halaqatanne asira halaqata histti sunththides.
Isttika asaas ubba wode pirdida; bana deexxida yo7oza Musekko ehida shin deexxontta yo7oza ubbaa barkka wursida.
Hessafe guye Musey ba bollo Yootore moyziin Yootorey guye ba dere simmides.

footnotes.text: El7ezeere guussi Ibraaweta qaalara, «Xoossay maaddides» guussa.
